phase: ECB-QFA-materiality-aligned OECD non-consolidated aggregate reference gate
purpose: Execute one new gate using an independently sourced ECB QFA internal-consistency materiality benchmark. Preserve exact OECD row semantics and ESA2010 S1M/L/F2 structural zero; evaluate instrument-quarter identities with exact decimal arithmetic and quarter-specific ECB EUR/RON reference rates.

ecb_exchange_rate.required_period_match: exact same 49 quarters as OECD gate

official_materiality_rule.threshold_million_ron_by_quarter: 10 * ECB EXR.Q.RON.EUR.SP00.A observation for the same quarter
official_materiality_rule.provenance: ECB 2013 explicit acceptability rule, with EUR 10 million materiality continuity in 2020/2022/2024 QFA quality reports

exact_decimal_gate.numeric_type: base-10 Decimal parsed directly from provider lexemes

identities_per_measure_period_instrument.formula: sum of H+C+F+G+BNR+X net for one F2-F8 instrument
S1 net - (S11+S12+S13+S1M net) for one F2-F8 instrument
S1 net + S2 net for one F2-F8 instrument

exact_decimal_gate.pass_rule: Every required identity for every common quarter, measure and instrument must have an absolute EUR-equivalent discrepancy strictly below EUR 10 million. Aggregate F2-F8 identity is also required below the same benchmark.

promotion_rule: A complete PASS authorizes a separate explicit promotion assessment for sectoral_financial_positions only. It cannot promote Accounting Spine instruments, activate behaviour, authorize parameter estimation or alter any historical failed gate.
failure_rule: Any source/FX access failure is INDETERMINATE. Any nonexception missing/duplicate row, semantic conflict, missing ECB exchange rate, nonfinite numeric value, or any required instrument-quarter identity at or above EUR 10 million is FAIL with no promotion.

execution_policy.activation_condition: pull_request on exact branch AND github.run_attempt > 1
